claims.claim: Art critique compares a work with its stated intention using observable features. Describe before interpreting: line, shape, proportion, value and space are evidence you can discuss. Then explain how those features contribute to the intended effect and propose a specific revision. A critique should distinguish craft objectives from subjective preference, cultural context and accessibility. Improvement is not necessarily making every drawing realistic.

locators.limitations: Not universal criteria for artistic worth
